messages:
Priya R: quick heads-up: starting onboarding for Cust Delta's LoRA (UmbraFlux) into staging. pushed branch cust-delta/umbra-lora-staging. did a tiny smoke and saw invoice cents disappearing in a few cases. putting evalpack in GDrive :link:
Danielle M: good call. drop the evalpack name and the highest-failure prompt id?
Priya R: evalpack name is cust-delta-invoice-smokepack-v1. top failing prompt id 0172: 'Total due: $12,345.67' model returns '12,345' (missing .67) in ~23% of long-context runs.
Matt K: hmm probably tokenizer id mismatch. Was the customer's tokenizer included in the LoRA training? any remap step during merge?
Priya R: they used a patched tokenizer cust_delta_tok_v2 during finetune but our merge applied LoRA directly against umbrafux-base tokenizer. suspect token id drift, amplified by int4 quant.
Sanjeev: plan: (1) run a tokenmap diff between base and cust tok v2, (2) run fp16 smoke to check if quant is the issue, (3) run int4 without remap and with remap. I'll queue the heavy runs on dedicated later.
Danielle M: I'll run the tokenmap diff: `python3 tools/tokenmap_diff.py --base models/umbra-base/tokenizer.json --other customer/tokenizers/cust_delta_tok_v2.json`
Danielle M: diff snippet:
```
@@
- "$": 345
+ "$": 1023
- ".": 56
+ ".": 512
@@
```
Danielle M: punctuation token ids shifted, so byte-level inputs will map to different embedding indices.
Matt K: that explains numeric collapse. LoRA embedding patch will bind to wrong indices if token ids differ.
Priya R: there's a small helper: `scripts/rebase_lora_tokenids.py` that can remap LoRA weight keys to the target tokenizer. using `--target-tokenizer customer/tokenizers/cust_delta_tok_v2.json` should do it.
Sanjeev: I'll run fp16 baseline: `./bench/run_quick_eval.sh --model umbrafux-lora-staged --quant none --prompts evalpacks/cust-delta-invoice-smokepack-v1 --out /tmp/umbra_fp16.json` then two int4 runs: `--quant int4` and `--quant int4 --apply-token-remap scripts/cust-delta-remap.json`.
Priya R: perfect. Matt, can you add a unit test to the smoke harness to assert cents are preserved for currency prompts? Should fail pre-remap and pass post-remap.
Matt K: will add tests/smoke/currency_cents.test in a tiny PR.
EvalBot: quick-eval job started (job id ej-99231) on dedicated-gpu-6. ETA ~12m. :eyes:
Sanjeev: fp16 finished: cents preserved 98.7% (baseline). int4 w/o remap: 74.1%. int4 with remap: 96.4%. Full logs: /mnt/results/ej-99231/summary.json
Priya R: that confirms remap fixes most of the regression. we should automate this during adapter merges when tokenizer differences detected.
Matt K: agree. add an onboarding pipeline step: detect tokenizer mismatch, generate mapping, apply to LoRA embedding keys. include a `--skip-remap` flag for advanced use.
Danielle M: PR ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/adapter-onboard/pull/421 includes scripts, tests, and docs update to docs/onboarding.md
Priya R: thanks. follow-up actions: (a) merge with remap applied, (b) run full smokepack (800 prompts) post-merge, (c) schedule overnight dedicated validation. ops-bot, reserve dedicated-gpu-6 for 02:00-04:00 UTC.
ops-bot: reservation confirmed for dedicated-gpu-6 2025-05-21T02:00:00Z to 2025-05-21T04:00:00Z  reservation id res-74411
Matt K: also adding a note to the release checklist: run tokenmap diff for any customer-supplied tokenizer. saved us here. :thumbsup:
